policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This is a timeline/summary page for the EU AI Act, not the full legislative text. Phased implementation: prohibitions Feb 2025, GPAI rules Aug 2025, majority of rules Aug 2026, high-risk in regulated products Aug 2027. Digital Omnibus package may delay high-risk rules pending harmonised standards.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The timeline document frames AI governance primarily around staged safety regulation—prohibitions, high-risk system rules, transparency obligations, and enforcement—suggesting a consumer and public safety orientation. Secondary frames include innovation enablement (regulatory sandboxes, support tools) and implicit fundamental rights concerns via transparency and prohibitions.
